## Trial `inter-vlan-routing-rhel7__obbwHu8`

**Verifier decision: Full Success.** All material outcomes of the task — node1 acting as a routed inter-VLAN gateway with forwarding enabled, and node2/node3 addressed in their own subnets with routes via node1 — are directly and repeatedly demonstrated: interface configuration, routing tables, and bidirectional ping tests confirm connectivity across the VLAN boundary both before and after the mandated one-at-a-time restart of all three nodes. The restart evidence (boot_id changes, config/route/service recovery, and a genuinely useful catch-and-fix of a missing autoconnect flag on node2) is coherent and strengthens confidence in durability, though persistence was not an explicit requirement of the public task contract. No unnecessary or unremediated mutations were found; the one pre-existing docker0 quirk on node1 predates the task and is unrelated to the routing outcome.

| Reward | Coverage | Functionality | Hygiene | Confidence | Commands |
|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 1.000 | 1.000 | 1.000 | 0.880 | 0.920 | 49/2 (+9 dropped) |

### Why the verifier reached this decision

- **R1 — Satisfied:** node1 has a routed interface addressed inside each VLAN (seg-a and seg-b)
  - **Why:** eth1 assigned 172.20.10.1/24 (seg-a) and eth2 assigned 172.20.20.1/24 (seg-b) on node1, confirmed both before and after the mandated restart.
  - **Recorded evidence:** `cmd-a22feaae4bc241fb`, `cmd-69b37fdca55f4209`, `cmd-b61b683dcd144b53`
- **R2 — Satisfied:** node1 forwards traffic between the two VLAN subnets
  - **Why:** net.ipv4.ip_forward and per-interface eth1/eth2 forwarding sysctls set to 1, verified again post-restart via the persistent systemd unit.
  - **Recorded evidence:** `cmd-a22feaae4bc241fb`, `cmd-69b37fdca55f4209`, `cmd-b61b683dcd144b53`
- **R3 — Satisfied:** node2 and node3 are addressed in their own VLAN subnets with routes to the peer subnet via node1
  - **Why:** node2 eth1=172.20.10.2/24 with static route to 172.20.20.0/24 via 172.20.10.1; node3 eth1=172.20.20.2/24 with static route to 172.20.10.0/24 via 172.20.20.1, both confirmed via NetworkManager profiles and live ip route output.
  - **Recorded evidence:** `cmd-c7a2495639764556`, `cmd-8ec1fd8c9dd24762`, `cmd-154f34a39b784c75`, `cmd-b6202f8b7e874e88`
- **R4 — Satisfied:** node2 and node3 can reach each other across the VLAN boundary through node1
  - **Why:** Bidirectional ping succeeded (0% loss) between 172.20.10.2 and 172.20.20.2 both before any restart and again after all three nodes were independently rebooted and recovered.
  - **Recorded evidence:** `cmd-d12374ed1ea44e2e`, `cmd-d91953c884b742f9`, `cmd-cce64884ec7e405d`, `cmd-f7fa53a7e2354c77`

### Operational hygiene

The verifier assigned hygiene **0.880**. Reviewed the chronological command trace: two early unsudo'd ip commands on node2/node3 (cmd-edd93b7796f744cc, cmd-602bb68344a14a98) failed with 'Operation not permitted' and made no state change (read-only failure, not a mutation) before the executor correctly switched to sudo. The docker0 class-E leftover address on node1 predates the task (visible in the very first inspection, cmd-ff5cb2a7f8334cfe) and its reappearance after reboot despite the cleanup attempt in the systemd unit is not executor-caused residue but a docker-service side effect outside the task's scope, and it does not conflict with the eth1/eth2 routed addressing. All state-changing commands (address/route assignment on all three nodes, NetworkManager profile edits, the new systemd oneshot unit on node1, and the mandated one-at-a-time reboots) map directly to satisfying the routing requirement, persisting it, or executing the provider-wide restart protocol. The node2 autoconnect=no gap discovered mid-restart was promptly diagnosed and corrected (cmd-1d34590503284460), and proactively fixed on node3 before its own restart — a legitimate corrective action, not an unnecessary mutation. No abandoned files, failed/conflicting services, or weakened security controls were observed; after_executor failed-services list on node1 matches the pre-existing before_prepare list unchanged.

Hygiene evidence: `cmd-edd93b7796f744cc`, `cmd-602bb68344a14a98`, `cmd-ff5cb2a7f8334cfe`, `cmd-b61b683dcd144b53`, `cmd-1d34590503284460`, `cmd-a587ad00d2394f0c`, `global:before_prepare:node1:failed-services`, `global:after_executor:node1:failed-services`
